description: Gradient blue card that glows on hover with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: On hover, box-shadow becomes #2c2b2b 5px 5px, #2d2d2d 10px 10px, #3c3b3b 15px 15px, #363535 20px 20px, #f02eaa 25px 25px, box-shadow becomes #000000 0px -23px 25px 0px inset, #000000 0px -36px 30px 0px inset, #000000 0px -79px 40px 0px inset, #000000 0px 2px 1px, #000000 0px 4px 2px, #000000 0px 8px 4px, #000000 0px 16px 8px, #000000 0px 32px 16px. On focus, box-shadow becomes #000000 0px -23px 25px 0px inset, #000000 0px -36px 30px 0px inset, #000000 0px -79px 40px 0px inset, #000000 0px 2px 1px, #000000 0px 4px 2px, #000000 0px 8px 4px, #000000 0px 16px 8px, #000000 0px 32px 16px.
